record.title: ERR_TIMED_OUT and ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE being observed by Cloudflare Customers

updates.body:
Cloudflare has identified an issue affecting customers whose traffic passes through an external vendor firewall.  Customers may observe:


ERR_TIMED_OUT on standard HTTPS websites
ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE on non-standard HTTPS ports (e.g., 8443)



We're investigating to confirm the root cause and possible fixes.
